test_title: RRB NTPC - Graduate 2025 (CBT 1) Foundational Full Test - 01
subject: general
question: Eight executives, Arun, Bavya, Divya, Eswar, Hina, Kalyan, Lokesh and Mayank are sitting in a conference room around the rectangle table facing the center at an equal distance from each other. Eswar is sitting second to the right of Kalyan. Kalyan is sitting immediate right to Arun, who is to the immediate right of Lokesh. Arun is sitting just opposite to Bavya. Divya is sitting in between Lokesh and Hina. If there are three of them on each side of the long side of the table, and one each on the short side of the table, who is sitting opposite to Mayank?
solution:
As per the given information the sitting arrangements:

1. Arun is sitting just opposite to Bavya.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e8aa6d9618eb9ff72af48a3075f794dc46af3464d952079937ebc38ab35b1d12.png] 

2. Eswar is sitting second to the right of Kalyan and Kalyan is sitting immediate right to Arun, who is to the immediate right of Lokesh.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/fe20829ac2812ef7a7d035a176613511f2bf33a694977f009597fd39bfd02004.png] 

3. Divya is sitting in between Lokesh and Hina.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/102c871d4e837c9492ff05bfb498f971ea0b19e56b8a2f1d928e4c67e720f1ee.png] 

4. The remaining person Mayank is sitting between Kalyan and Eswar.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/691e3fd5bc45b4659c0f481cc80202075715a8cac1744650af621467a2c38db5.png] 

Here, Divya is sitting opposite to Mayank.

Hence, the correct answer is** "Divya".**
